_comment: App Service FREE (F1) deployment. Differs from site-config.json in one structural way: there is no storage mount, because artefacts are baked into the image (docker build --target standalone). Everything else here follows from documented F1 limits.

_measured_fit.verdict: Fits, with ~58% headroom. Measured fasttext+union, one isolated process.
_measured_fit.cold_start: No Always On on F1, so the app unloads when idle and cold-starts on the next request: ~10 s to load the model and rebuild the TF-IDF matrix. Baking data/interim keeps this from becoming ~56 s.
_measured_fit.cpu_budget: 60 CPU-minutes/day and 3 minutes per 5. A cold start is ~10 CPU-seconds, a query ~0.13 s. The budget is real but generous for demo traffic; it is the reason not to put a crawler or a load test on this.

name: medsearch-app-free

siteConfig._alwaysOn_comment: Must stay false. F1 does not support Always On; setting it true fails the deployment.
siteConfig._no_storage_comment: Deliberately no azureStorageAccounts. Artefacts are in the image, so the app has no external dependency and no storage account to pay for.

appSettings._comment: F1 is slow to pull a ~1.5 GB image on first start. 300 s is not padding.
appSettings.name: WEBSITES_CONTAINER_START_TIME_LIMIT

appSettings._comment: Baked-in paths, matching the standalone target's COPY destinations.
appSettings.name: MEDSEARCH_DATA_DIR

appSettings._comment: One shared core on F1. Threads past the first only add contention (ADR-008).
appSettings.name: OMP_NUM_THREADS

appSettings._comment: Skips the memory floor's training budget: this container only serves.
appSettings.name: MEDSEARCH_MIN_FREE_MEMORY_GB

sku._comment: F1 Free: 1 GB memory per plan, 1 GB storage, 60 CPU-min/day, 1 shared instance, no Always On, no custom domain or TLS beyond *.azurewebsites.net.
sku.name: F1
